lines: Daniel Robert Bachelet, Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 71,286 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds are up to ₹1.08 crore, arriving around Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are locked in for 6 months from allotment, so more value may follow later.
Retained holding is unknown: pre-offer holding not confirmed from the documents.
